title: 한국해양과학기술원법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Management of Revenue-Producing Business)
(1) KIOST shall establish and manage a separate account for revenue-producing business in order to clearly distinguish income and expenditure arising from the operation of such business.
(2) Where KIOST conducts revenue-producing business under Article 12 (1) of the Act, it shall report its business plan to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries no later than 90 days before the beginning of the fiscal year and submit a business performance report and financial statements within 90 days after the end of that fiscal year. <Amended on March 24, 2013>
